      "observations": [
        "All owned implementation and changed test hunks were read. isSend is computed once before format decisions and reused by later FCC handling. Pure plaintext ignores the requested deliveryFormat and records PlainText; HTML maps plaintext/html/both to the corresponding enum, with Auto as the nullish default. deliveryFormat is always assigned before resolving send-only downgrade behavior.",
        "Pure plaintext sets forcePlainText true and multipart false for any mode. HTML sendNow/sendLater resolve Auto through nodeTreeConvertible, using Both on conversion exceptions; explicit HTML/Both values map to MIME flags. HTML draft/template save leaves both flags at constructor defaults false. The existing comment saying flags are not applied to save operations is overbroad; it should say HTML save operations because pure-plaintext saves take the first branch.",
        "The actual enum values are 0/1/2/3 and Unset4. Accepted MimeMessage copies headers and writes draft-info for queue/background/draft/template modes; getXMozillaDraftInfo serializes deliveryFormat. The owned API now supplies the specific intent rather than relying on Unset. Actual editor reopening and the native conversion algorithm remain bounded; the tests inspect raw saved data, not a reopened compose window.",
        "Changed shared assertions distinguish multipart sending from direct-body saving and saved deliveryformat values. The dedicated cases directly check HTML content/type and format0, then plain type and format1. All changed assertion calls have non-empty messages; “One draft saved” lacks should but correctly states its expected count and is not a defect by that word alone.",
        "No formatter, test, message send/save, DOM-conversion, MIME or editor run occurred. The author explicitly keeps auto downgrade despite the original dependency comment’s request to remove it; dependency1545930 is separately partial and cannot prove full original discussion.",
        "Full D304949 timeline/current summary is read, with zero actual inline/history edits. The author separates stored intent from send MIME controls and explicitly keeps manual downgrade. LGTM, intermediate lint failure, later completed remote build and Green Try remain historical, separate from the checked source and raw-message assertions.",
        "The header and saved HTML tests do not open an editor. Related1545930 remains a separately partial dependency, not this row’s required primary, and no missing history or runtime proof is inferred."
